# Adverse events

### Read and clean data

Read data
```{r}
dl2 <- readRDS(file="02_data_derived/all_data_by_visit.rds")
de <- dl2$events
```

Read exception ID numbers:
```{r}
except <- readRDS(file = "02_data_derived/exceptions.rds")
```

Remove prefixed "haendelse_" and "handelse
```{r}
setnames(de, function(x) gsub("haendelse_|handelse_", "", x))
```

Remove incorrect registration of starting date on one participant:
```{r}
incor_startd <- as.integer(except$incorrect_startdato)
stopifnot(length(incor_startd) == 1)
de <- de[!(is.na(startdato) & ID %in% incor_startd)]
```

Fix typos in MedDRA classifications:
```{r}
de[meddra_pt == "decreased  appetite",                      meddra_pt := "Decreased appetite"]
de[meddra_pt == "Dizziness ",                               meddra_pt := "Dizziness"]
de[meddra_pt %in% c("feeling  jittery", "feeling jittery"), meddra_pt := "Feeling jittery"]
de[meddra_pt %in% c("Hot flushes", "hot flush"),            meddra_pt := "Hot flush"]
de[meddra_pt == "palpitations",                             meddra_pt := "Palpitations"]
```

Add variables: `d_day0`, `SAS`, `trt`
```{r}
de[, date := startdato]
de2 <- add_derived_data(de)
de2[, date := NULL]
de2[, d_day28 := d_day0 + 28]
```

### Derive length of adverse event

```{r}
# Length of adverse event
de2[, d_length := as.numeric(slutdato_haendelse - startdato) + 1]
de2[d_length %in% 1:2, f_length := "1-2 days"]
de2[d_length %in% 3:5, f_length := "3-5 days"]
de2[d_length %in% 6:9, f_length := "6-9 days"]
de2[d_length %in% 10:14, f_length := "10-14 days"]
de2[d_length > 14 | (is.na(slutdato_haendelse) & 
                     status == "Igangværende" & 
                     (as.numeric(d_day28 - startdato) +1) > 14), 
    f_length := "More than 14 days"]
```


### Convert variables to factors

```{r}
# Serious
de2[, investigator_alvorlighed := factor(investigator_alvorlighed, 
                                         levels = c("Ja", "Nej"),
                                         labels = c("Yes", "No"))]

# Severity
de2[, gradering := factor(gradering,
                          levels = levels(gradering),
                          labels = c("Mild", "Moderate", "Severe",
                                     "Life-threatening", "Fatal"))]

# Relationship to trial product
de2[, investigator_relation := factor(investigator_relation, 
                                      levels = c("Ja (mulig, sandsynlig, sikker)",
                                                 "Nej (ingen, usandsynlig)"),
                                      labels = c("Yes (possible, probable, certain)", 
                                                 "No (none, unlikely)"))]

# Leading to premature discontinuation of trial product
de2[, handling := factor(handling, 
                         levels = c("Stoppet", "Ingen"),
                         labels = c("Yes", "No"))]

# Length of adverse event
de2[, f_length := factor(f_length, 
                         levels = c("1-2 days", "3-5 days", "6-9 days",
                                    "10-14 days", "More than 14 days"))]
```

Save derived adverse events data
```{r}
saveRDS(de2, file = "02_data_derived/adverse_events_derived.rds")
```

# Admissions, deaths and suicide attempts

## Admissions and deaths

### Read and prepare data

Extract data from "Alle indlæggelser" and "Dødsfald" for randomized individuals:
```{r}
dl2 <- readRDS(file="02_data_derived/all_data_by_visit.rds")
rand_id <- readRDS(file = "02_data_derived/all_subject_ids.rds")[!is.na(rand_id)]$ID

# Only data from randomized individuals
dc <- dl2$conclusion[ID %in% rand_id]
stopifnot(nrow(dc[, uniqueN(ID)]) ==nrow(dc))
```

Extract variables of interest:
```{r}
death_cols <- c("ID", "doedsfald", "type_doed", "doedsaarsag", "kommentar_doed", 
                "ddsfald_complete")
adm_cols <- grep("^indlagt|pam", names(dc), value = TRUE)
cols <- c(death_cols, adm_cols)

dc2 <- dc[, .SD, .SDcols = cols]
```

Add variables: `trt`, `d_day0`, `d_day28` and `c_SAS`:
```{r}
dc2[, date := pam_dato_1]
dc2 <- add_derived_data(dc2)
dc2[, date := NULL]
dc2[, d_day28 := d_day0 + 28]
```


### Derive hospital contacts variables

Columns with start dates of hospital contacts:
```{r}
# Columns related to PAM contacts:
pam_cols <- grep("^pam_dato_", names(dc2), value = TRUE)
# Columns related to psychiatric inpatient admissions:
psyk_cols <- grep("^indlagt_psyk_start", names(dc2), value = TRUE)
# Columns related to somatic admissions:
soma_cols <- grep("^indlagt_soma_start", names(dc2), value = TRUE)
```

Count PAM contacts in total and at day 28:
```{r}
dc2[, pam_count := rowSums(!is.na(.SD)), .SDcols = pam_cols]
dc2[, pam_count28 := rowSums(mapply(function(col) col <= d_day28, .SD),
                                na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = pam_cols]
```

Count psychiatric inpatient admissions in total and at day 28:
```{r}
dc2[, psyk_count := rowSums(!is.na(.SD)), .SDcols = psyk_cols]
dc2[, psyk_count28 := rowSums(mapply(function(col) col <= d_day28, .SD),
                                na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = psyk_cols]
```

Count somatic admissions in total and at day 28:
```{r}
# Somatic admissions
dc2[, soma_count := rowSums(!is.na(.SD)), .SDcols = soma_cols]
dc2[, soma_count28 := rowSums(mapply(function(col) col <= d_day28, .SD),
                                na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = soma_cols]
```

Count all hospital contacts in total and at day 28:
```{r}
dc2[, hc_count := rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = c("pam_count", "psyk_count", "soma_count")]
dc2[, hc_count28 := rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = c("pam_count28", "psyk_count28", "soma_count28")]
```


### Derive death related variables 

Create binary variables indicating death during follow-up and by day 28:
```{r}
dc2[, death := ifelse(!is.na(doedsfald), 1, 0)]
dc2[, death28 := ifelse(!is.na(doedsfald) & doedsfald <= d_day28, 1, 0)]
```

Create factor variable for reason of death during follow-up and by day 28:
```{r}
dc2[, type_doed := factor(type_doed,
                          levels = c("Ulykke",
                                     "Selvmord",
                                     "Somatisk sygdom",
                                     "Ukendt"),
                          labels = c("Accident",
                                     "Suicide",
                                     "Somatic illness",
                                     "Unknown"))]

dc2[, type_doed28 := factor(
  ifelse(death28 == 1, as.character(type_doed), NA),
  levels = levels(type_doed)
)]
```

Save derived admissions and deaths data:
```{r}
saveRDS(dc2, "02_data_derived/admissions_derived.rds")
```


## Suicide attempts

### Read and format data on suicide attempts

Extract data from "indlæggelser og selvmordsforsøg siden sidst":
```{r}
data_by_category <- readRDS(file="02_data_derived/data_by_category.rds")
ds <- data_by_category$adm_data
```

Pivot data to wide format:
```{r}
ds2 <- dcast(ds, ID + c_visit + date ~ orig, value.var = "c_value")
```

Add `d_day0`, `d_day28`, `c_SAS` and `trt`:
```{r}
ds3 <- add_derived_data(ds2)
stopifnot(nrow(ds3[is.na(d_day0)]) == 0)
ds3[, d_day28 := d_day0 + 28]
```

Convert number of suicide attempts to numeric:
```{r}
ds3[, selvmord_outcome_antal := as.numeric(selvmord_outcome_antal)]
```

Ensure no individuals has missing day 28 assessment and more than one suicide 
attempt at month 6: 
```{r}
ds3[, i_day28  := any(c_visit == "day28"), by = ID]
stopifnot(nrow(ds3[i_day28 == FALSE & c_visit == "month6" & selvmord_outcome_antal > 1]) == 0)
```

Save data on suicide attempts by visit: 
```{r}
saveRDS(ds3, "02_data_derived/suicides_by_visits_derived.rds")
```


## Combine data on admissions, deaths and suicide 

Count suicide attempts during follow-up and by day 28: 
```{r}
ds4 <- ds3[, .(
  suic_count   = sum(selvmord_outcome_antal, na.rm = TRUE),
  suic_count28 = sum(selvmord_outcome_antal[!is.na(selvmord_outcome_dato) & 
                                                 selvmord_outcome_dato <= d_day28], 
                     na.rm = TRUE)
  ), by = c("ID", "d_day28")]
```

Merge admissions, deaths and suicide attempts data: 
```{r}
dads <- merge(dc2[, .(ID, c_SAS, trt, death, death28, type_doed, type_doed28,
                                   hc_count, hc_count28,pam_count, pam_count28, psyk_count, 
                                   psyk_count28, soma_count, soma_count28)], 
              ds4[, .(ID, suic_count, suic_count28)],
              by = c("ID"))
```

Save derived data on admissions, suicide attempts and deaths:
```{r}
saveRDS(dads, "02_data_derived/admissions_deaths_suicides_derived.rds")
```
